summary: Expose ParentNode.children as a live SameObject HTMLCollection of element children only.

requirements.receiver: Document, DocumentFragment, or Element implementing ParentNode

semantics.contents: direct Element children only, not Text/Comment nodes

caveats: A copied List<Element> is not equivalent.

tests.name: collection is live and same object
tests.input: const e=document.createElement('div'); const c=e.children; e.append(document.createElement('i')); console.log(c===e.children,c.length);
